processing_order: Audit raw sources -> harmonize each source -> clean each source separately in Step 3 -> reconcile/merge -> aggregate students

sources.source_title: HarvardX Person-Course Academic Year 2013 De-Identified dataset, version 3.0
sources.source_verification: Verified against the published filename and MD5 checksum
sources.selection_rationale: Official de-identified person-course release with documentation, a persistent DOI, and extensive reuse in MOOC research.
sources.known_limitations: HarvardX-only release; self-reported demographics; aggregate person-course records; no video-duration variable.

sources.source_title: Expanded HarvardX-MITx MOOC person-course file supplied with the project
sources.source_verification: Source link supplied by the project owner; exact remote filename/version is not exposed by the current Kaggle page and requires manual provenance confirmation
sources.selection_rationale: Adds MITx records and broader course coverage using the same person-course schema needed for cross-course analysis.
sources.known_limitations: Derived file with an index column and no independently published checksum or version identifier; provenance is weaker than the Harvard Dataverse source.
